integrity: At fixed total, Shannon equality is converted exactly to equality of the integer product Q=product n_i^{n_i}, while Simpson equality is equality of the integer squared-abundance sum. All 28628 integer partitions through total 30 are exhaustively generated, with partition counts cross-checked independently by dynamic programming.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unlabeled strictly positive integer species-abundance profiles and exact equality of the order-1 and order-2 Hill summaries, optionally with richness. It is a finite census-resolution result and does not assert finite-dimensional identification for arbitrary real abundance distributions.
title: Two Hill diversities identify every integer abundance profile through 23 individuals, but not 24
